error_pattern: Process completed with exit code 1. (Build test project step failed across multiple unrelated jobs simultaneously; job logs unavailable: 'Failed to fetch logs for job').
analysis: The job failed at a generic 'Build test project' step with only 'Process completed with exit code 1' reported and no underlying compiler errors, test failures, or job log content available (log fetch itself failed). The PR under analysis (#20143) only edits csproj InternalsVisibleTo declarations in Aspire.Hosting and Aspire.Hosting.Radius, and does not touch Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost, Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost.Tests, or any code path that RemoteHost's build depends on. This is the same signature seen recurring across many unrelated PRs and jobs (Hosting.RemoteHost, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure.Kubernetes, Playground, Dashboard), indicating a transient CI/runner infrastructure problem (e.g. build agent contention, disk/network flakiness) rather than a code issue.
